en: Black‑and‑white historic image of a small wooden railway station with decorative trim and a gabled roof. A sign above the entrance reads "KLOCKRIKE". People in early 20th‑century clothing, including railway staff in uniform, women in long skirts and hats, and children, stand on the platform in front of the station. A railcar or train coach is visible in the left foreground on the tracks, and a horse‑drawn carriage appears to the right.
